title: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: A practical introduction to core data structures, algorithmic thinking, and complexity analysis.
syllabus: We will cover arrays, linked structures, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, hashing, sorting, searching, and algorithm analysis. Grades are based on six assignments weighted by points possible. Late work is accepted through September 5, 2026, 23:59 UTC without an automatic penalty. Graded submissions are locked.

title: Modern Web Development
description: Build accessible, maintainable web applications using semantic HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and React.
syllabus: Topics include semantic UI, responsive CSS, TypeScript fundamentals, component design, routing, forms, state management, and frontend testing. The course emphasizes small, composable modules and readable code.

title: Applied Data Science
description: An applied survey of data preparation, exploratory analysis, visualization, and introductory modeling.
syllabus: Students will practice cleaning data, exploratory analysis, descriptive statistics, feature construction, model evaluation, and communicating findings. Assignments are designed as short applied exercises rather than long projects.

title: Human-Centered Product Design
description: Learn to frame product problems, understand users, prototype solutions, and evaluate design decisions.
syllabus: The course moves from problem framing through interviews, journey mapping, wireframing, prototyping, usability testing, and design critique. Each assignment contributes to a lightweight product case study.
